depicts: A split composite: on the left a heap of rubbish under an orange sky, on the right a forest waterfall and green pool, divided by a curved green line.
composition: Diagonal curved divider slightly left of centre splits the frame; rubbish fills the left half, waterfall pool the right; ferns and rocks cross the divider at bottom; full-frame.
tone_and_contrast: Left half dark brown and murky with orange sky corner; right half saturated green and teal; strong contrast between halves, dark left side has low detail separation.
sharpness_and_artifacts: Left side has a hazy, blended look with soft mid-tones; right side is sharp; visible smooth gradient overlay on the left; no watermark.
scan_first_read: A before-and-after of polluted waste versus clean waterfall nature; clear environmental message.
